steps.title: Isolate Sub-culturing
steps.instruction: Sub-culture frozen isolates on Trypticase Soy + 5% Sheep Blood Agar plates (BAPs) or equivalent media.

substeps.instruction: If the culture is pure, pick an isolated colony and streak it on a fresh BAP.
Incubate at 35°C overnight (24±2 hours) in aerobic conditions.

steps.title: Bacterial Cell Harvesting
steps.instruction: Prepare the bacterial sample for DNA extraction from either broth or colony.

substeps.instruction: From broth: Transfer 1-1.5 mL of culture to a labelled microcentrifuge tube, centrifuge at 5,000 g for 10 minutes, remove supernatant, and store the pellet at -20°C.
Direct from colony: Use a 1 μL loop to collect overnight growth and add to a labelled microcentrifuge tube containing the appropriate extraction buffer for gram positive or gram negative bacteria.

steps.title: DNA Extraction: Gram Positive Bacteria
steps.instruction: Perform lysis and extraction for Gram Positive samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 180 μL of prepared enzymatic lysis (ELB)-lysozyme mixture to the tube and resuspend the pellet (or add overnight growth directly to the mixture).
Incubate at 56°C for 30 minutes, vortexing periodically.
Optional: Add 4 μL of RNase A, vortex, and incubate at RT for 3-5 minutes.
Add 25 μL Proteinase K and 200 μL Buffer AL to the tube.
Vortex thoroughly and incubate at 56°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Extraction: Gram Negative Bacteria
steps.instruction: Perform lysis and extraction for Gram Negative samples.

substeps.instruction: If ATL buffer is cloudy, heat at 50-55°C until clear.
Add 180 μL Buffer ATL to the tube and resuspend the pellet (or add overnight growth directly to the buffer).
Add 20 μL Proteinase K and vortex.
Incubate at 56°C for a minimum of 1 hour or up to overnight, vortexing periodically.
Optional: Add 4 μL of RNase A, vortex, and incubate at RT for 3-5 minutes.
Add 200 μL Buffer AL to the tube.
Vortex thoroughly and incubate at 56°C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Purification via Spin Column
steps.instruction: Purify the extracted DNA using DNeasy Mini spin columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL ethanol (200 proof) to each tube, vortex thoroughly, and pulse spin.
Pipet the mixture into a labelled DNeasy Mini spin column and centrifuge at 6,000xg for 1 minute; discard flow-through and collection tube.
Add 500 μL Buffer AW1, centrifuge for 1 minute at 6,000xg (8,000rpm), and discard flow-through and collection tube.
Add 500 μL Buffer AW2, centrifuge for 1 minute at 6,000xg (8,000rpm), and discard flow-through and collection tube.
Transfer the spin column to a new collection tube and centrifuge for 1 minute at 18,000-20,000xg (14,000rpm) to dry.
Place the column in a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and pipet 100 μL Buffer EB directly onto the membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge for 1 minute at 18,000-20,000xg (14,000rpm) to elute.
Store DNA at 4°C for up to 48 hours or -20°C for long-term storage.

steps.title: DNA Quantification (Qubit)
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA using the Qubit dsDNA BR Assay Kit (recommended input 100-500ng).

substeps.instruction: Ensure reagents are at room temperature; vortex and pulse spin standards and dye.
Prepare working solution: dilute 7 μL Qubit dsDNA BR Reagent 200X in 1393 μL Qubit dsDNA BR Buffer in a low-bind tube.
Label assay tubes for Standard #1, #2, and each sample (label tops only).
Add 190 μL working solution to Standard tubes and 196 μL to sample tubes.
Add 10 μL of each Qubit Standard to respective tubes and 4 μL DNA sample to sample tubes; vortex and pulse spin.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Set Qubit to 'dsDNA Broad Range' assay and read Standard #1 and Standard #2.
Set sample volume to 4 µL and read each sample; record stock concentrations in the DNA Prep workbook.

steps.title: DNA Quantification (NanoDrop)
steps.instruction: Perform secondary quantification and purity check using NanoDrop.

substeps.instruction: Select Nucleic Acid assay (specifically dsDNA).
Blank the instrument: Load 2 μL water on the lower pedestal, click 'Initiate', wipe pedestals, then load 2 μL EB and click 'Blank', wipe pedestals.
Load 2 μL of sample, click 'Measure', and record concentration, 260/280, and 260/230 ratios in the DNA Flex Workbook.
Clean pedestals with water and laboratory wipes after all samples are processed.

steps.title: Sample Sheet and Dilution Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA Flex Workbook and sample sheet for library prep.

substeps.instruction: Fill in the 'Initial dilution' tab of the DNA Flex Workbook.
Confirm/adjust i7 and i5 indexes (Columns D and E).
Ensure DNA input is 100-500 ng (Column J). Adjust volume multiplier if necessary. (Min input: 2 μL, Max: 30 μL).
Prepare the Sample Plate and Sample Sheet in the Illumina Experiment Manager.

steps.title: Tagmentation of Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Perform tagmentation using the Nextera DNA Flex chemistry.

substeps.instruction: Bring SPB, TSB, TWB, BLT, and TB1 to room temperature (TB1 from freezer).
Add calculated nuclease-free water (Column L) and adjusted DNA volume (Column K) to clean PCR tubes.
Mix by pipetting 5-10 times; store at 4-8°C overnight or proceed immediately.
Vortex BLT vigorously for 10 seconds and vortex TB1.
Prepare tagmentation master mix (per provided table), vortex thoroughly, and transfer 20 µL to each sample well.
Pipette up and down 10 times to mix the 50 µL reaction and resuspend beads.
Run FLEXTAG program in thermalcycler: 55°C for 15 minutes, then hold at 10°C (lid pre-heated).

steps.title: Post-Tagmentation Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean up tagmented DNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: If TSB has precipitates, heat at 37°C for 10 minutes and vortex.
Add 10 µL of TSB to the reaction, pipette up and down 10 times to resuspend beads.
Run FLEXPOST program: 37°C for 15 minutes, then hold at 10°C (lid pre-heated).
Remove EPM and indices from freezer to room temperature during incubation.
Quick spin tubes, place on magnet for 3 minutes until clear, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 100 µL TWB by pipetting; place on magnet for 3 minutes and discard supernatant.
Repeat TWB wash once more (total of two washes).
Perform a final addition of 100 µL TWB, resuspend, and place on magnet for at least 3 minutes.

steps.title: Amplify Tagmented DNA
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the tagmented libraries.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR master mix (per provided table), vortex, and spin down.
Remove the final TWB wash from samples while on the magnet and remove any excess liquid.
Remove tubes from magnet and immediately add 40 µL of PCR master mix; pipette to mix.
Add 5 µL of i7 index primers (orange caps) and 5 µL of i5 index primers (white caps) to the NTA tube.
Mix at least 10 times using a high volume (30 µL) to avoid bubbles.
Run FLEXPCR program: 68°C (3 min) -> 98°C (3 min) -> [98°C (45 sec) -> 62°C (30 sec) -> 68°C (2 min)] x 5 cycles -> 68°C (1 min) -> Hold 10°C.
Store at 4°C for up to 3 days or proceed to Clean Up Libraries.

steps.title: Library Clean Up
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified libraries using SPB beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 80% ethanol. Bring SPB and RSB (from freezer) to room temperature; vortex SPB.
Centrifuge PCR tubes at 280 x g for 1 minute if retrieved from cold storage.
Place tubes on magnet for 3-5 minutes; transfer 45 µL of supernatant to clean tubes.
Vortex and add 85 µL of SPB master mix to each well; pipette to mix 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 5 minutes, then place on magnet for 5 minutes.
While incubating, aliquot 15 µL SPB stock into new tubes.
Transfer 125 µL of supernatant to the 15 µL SPB tubes; pipette to mix 10 times (~85 µL volume).
Incubate at RT for 5 minutes, then place on magnet for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Add 180 µL 80% ethanol, incubate 30 seconds, and remove supernatant; repeat for a total of two washes.
Air dry beads on the magnet for 5 minutes.
Add 32 µL RSB, pipette to resuspend, and incubate at RT for 2-5 minutes.
Place on magnet for 3 minutes and transfer 30 µL of supernatant to a new tube.
Store at -20°C for up to 30 days or proceed to pooling.

steps.title: Pooling and Normalization
steps.instruction: Pool individual libraries and dilute to 1 nM.

substeps.instruction: Quantify individual libraries (Qubit HS or NanoDrop) and enter results in the workbook.
Pool 5 μL per sample (or 2.5 μL for small genomes) into a 1.5ml tube; vortex and spin down.
Quantify the pool (Qubit HS or NanoDrop) and record in the workbook.
Dilute the pool to 4 nM in a volume of 15 µL using RSB, based on workbook calculations (conversion factor 2.5).
Create 1 nM pool: Add 5 µl of 4 nM pool to 15 µL RSB in a low-bind tube; vortex and spin at 280 x g for 3 sec.
Store 1 nM library on ice or at -20°C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Cartridge and PhiX Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the iSeq cartridge and the PhiX spike-in.

substeps.instruction: Thaw cartridge (do not open foil bag) using one of three methods: 20-25°C water bath (6-18h), 2-8°C refrigerator (36h-1 week), or 20-25°C air (9-18h).
Dilute 1 nM pool to 200 pM: Add 20 µL of 1 nM pool to 80 µL RSB; vortex and centrifuge at 280 x g for 3 sec.
Prepare 1 nM PhiX: Add 2 µL of 10 nM PhiX to 18 µL RSB; vortex and centrifuge at 280 x g for 3 sec.
Dilute 1 nM PhiX to 200 pM: Add 20 µL of 1 nM PhiX to 80 µL RSB; vortex and centrifuge at 280 x g for 3 sec.
Spike-in: Add 2 µL of 200 pM PhiX to 100 µL of 200 pM pooled library; keep on ice.

steps.title: Flow Cell Loading
steps.instruction: Load the library and flow cell into the iSeq cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Remove cartridge from bag; tap label-side up on bench 5 times.
Pierce the Library reservoir with a tip to enlarge the hole; discard tip.
Add 20 µL of the diluted library (with PhiX) to the bottom of the reservoir.
Remove flow cell from package; insert into the cartridge slot until it clicks.

steps.title: Sequencing Run Setup
steps.instruction: Configure the iSeq instrument and start the run.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Generate FASTQ'. Enter Run Name (YYMMDD-Vet-LIRN-LAB).
Settings: Select 'Nextera DNA CD Indexes-24 index tube', Index Reads '2', Read 1 '151', Read 2 '151', and Adapter Trimming 'On'.
Enter Sample ID (Isolate ID), Sample Description (Organism with '-' instead of spaces), and Sample Project (VL-iSeq-LAB).
Place cartridge on tray (access window up) and select 'Close Door'.
Sign in to BaseSpace Sequence Hub, ensure 'run monitoring and storage' is checked, and select the run.
Wait 15 minutes for pre-run checks; the run starts automatically.
Select 'Eject Cartridge', remove cartridge and flow cell, and dispose of flow cell per institutional standards.
Select 'Close Door' to reload the tray.
Sign in to BaseSpace via web browser, select the run, and use the 'Share' function to send results via email.
